title: End-of-Support for ZscalerOS 24 for Branch Connector Deployments

blocks.text: Branch Connector appliances based on ZscalerOS 24 and earlier are no longer supported:

blocks.item: Virtual appliances are no longer supported on VMware platforms, Linux KVM, and Microsoft Hyper-V.
Hardware appliances are no longer supported on ZT-400, ZT-600, and ZT-800.

blocks.text: If your organization is running a Branch Connector deployment with ZscalerOS 24 or earlier, you must upgrade to ZscalerOS 42 or higher by December 31, 2026 to ensure service continuity. To learn more, see How to validate if a Zscaler VM is Running ZSOS24 needs redeployment on Zscaler Community. No action is required for customers with Branch Connectors running ZscalerOS 42.
This notice does not apply to Zero Trust Branch appliances.
